name: craft:right-sized-design
description: Is the structure sized to the problem: no abstraction without real callers, no speculative configuration, no pass-through layers? From the craft:right-sized-design skill.

artifact.type: code hunk (one module, class or diff hunk)

modules.name: speculative-structure
modules.purpose: Every abstraction in the hunk does work for more than one concrete case.

declaresInterfaceOrBase.instructions: Does this code declare an interface, abstract base class, factory, strategy or registry?

criteria.true: At least one such construct is declared here.

singleImplementationVisible.instructions: Within this code, does a declared interface, base class or strategy have exactly one implementation?

criteria.true: One implementation behind the abstraction is visible here.
criteria.false: Several implementations, or none declared here.

passThroughMethod.instructions: Does this code contain a method whose body only forwards its arguments to another call and returns the result?

criteria.true: A method adds nothing but a forwarding call.
criteria.false: Every method does some work of its own.

notForJev.judgement: How many real call sites does this abstraction have across the codebase?
notForJev.instead: Counting and cross-file: find references with the language server or grep, in code (P18/P21).

modules.name: speculative-configuration
modules.purpose: Options and flags exist because a caller varies them, not in case one might.

optionWithSingleValue.instructions: Does this code add a parameter, option or flag that is only ever given one value within this code?

criteria.true: A new knob with one value in sight.
criteria.false: Every new knob is given different values here, or none is added.

futureJustification.instructions: Does a comment in this code justify a structure by a possible future need, such as "in case" or "might need later"?

criteria.true: A comment defends structure by an imagined future use.
